Input images: Image 1 approved teal game skin reference for exact empty composition, vertical aspect and painterly finish; Image 2 original game tavern reference for camera and framing. These are supporting references only; generate a new scene.
Primary request: create a distinctly new skin called 长安夜市, a richly atmospheric warm night-market tavern. Portrait 720:1520 aspect ratio (approximately 0.474), full bleed, same camera as references. Deep indigo and purple velvet night awning draped across top 0-14%, bronze-gold rings and geometric fittings, star-motif woven brocade very subtle. Warm orange-red silk lanterns hang upper far corners, deep luminous turquoise and purple shadows in outer framing. Dark carved wooden geometric arch and narrow outer side framing; distant Chinese night-market architecture roofs and tiny lantern glows glimpsed ONLY beyond outer edges, adding depth. No people, no signs.
Critical composition: preserve large EMPTY evenly lit warm LIGHT pale parchment central playing surface x10-90%, y16-73%. It must be LIGHT cream for food-tile contrast, NOT a dark night background; unobstructed and only very subtle paper texture. Decoration only far side edges. The tabletop edge starts exactly at 73.5% of image height. Lower 26.5% is dark reddish polished wood table with warm reflections from lanterns, lower center empty for later controls. Cropped glowing copper hotpot with rich red broth at bottom-left, indigo ceramic vessel and wooden chopsticks bottom-right, restrained teal textiles or bronze market props only at extreme lower corners. Soft atmospheric steam at bottom-left, not over central area.
Style: premium detailed painterly casual game illustration like reference, dimensional and tactile, luxurious realistic painted silk, lacquered wood, ceramics and metallic light, cinematic amber lantern illumination against indigo-purple edge shadows. Strong distinct night-market lighting, no flat vector.
Absolutely NO words, lettering, calligraphy, logos, readable signs, people, food tiles, icons, buttons, phone frame, tray, badges, UI, or grid. NO objects intruding into blank playing area. Do not depict a framed painting within a wall; parchment is the main game surface.
